title: 623. Squirrel Simulation

examples.explanation: Round trips cost 12 and no first pick saves extra.
Fetch over distance 2, carry home over distance 1.
Round trips cost 12; fetching (2,2) first saves 2.

hints: Sum twice the tree-to-nut Manhattan distance over all nuts as the baseline.
Choosing nut i first replaces one tree leg with a squirrel leg, changing the total by dist(squirrel,i) - dist(tree,i).
Take the minimum such adjustment over all nuts and add it to the baseline.
